tactics:
induction x with
  | nil => intro bs; exact hnil bs
  | cons a as ih => intro bs; exact hcons a as bs (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: bs))

induction x with
  | nil => intro bs; rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hnil bs
  | cons a as ih => intro bs; rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hcons a as bs (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: bs))

induction x with
  | nil => intro bs; simp only [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hnil bs
  | cons a as ih => intro bs; simp only [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hcons a as bs (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: bs))
